sources.label: Unverified provenance marker: this manifest's ArtCraft facts are not proven against an installed app. The headless serve template states the bridge launch contract proven on PhotoCraft's CLI; a real PdfCraft CLI run must confirm the app honors it.

Verified CLI transport on pdfcraft-cli.exe 0.14.0: `tools` returned 179 JSON tool descriptors, and `run --script` with doc_create_multiple converted a generated cv.txt into an 858-byte PDF 1.7 artifact inside the confined out root; the `serve` subcommand is absent from this build, so the gateway uses `tools`/`run --script` per call.

Verified MCP automation on pdfcraft-cli.exe 0.14.0: `mcp --automation-read-root <tmp> --automation-write-root <tmp>` advertised 179 tools; doc_create_multiple converted a generated cv.txt into an 866-byte PDF 1.7 inside the write root, sha256 e51e871abfb9f3993ca4a27febd37423bde3ba7cad96e1ed07022c995dff4468.
